profile.headline: Life’s software and I engineer it constantly!
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Life’s motto: Giving is getting. This is why I love the qualities of self-expression, independence, and community strengthening. Any company I’m lucky enough to be a part of probably embodies those!

I LOVE the idea of hands-on learning: For myself and ESPECIALLY for apprentices, students, and interns I’ve been lucky to have instructed. Being a geek can be lonely, so fostering community through our mutual love of tech, across differences, is amazing!

Now, if I could bottle up the magic of self-expression, I would. Nothing beats bringing programmers together and talking about anything but programming!

Lastly, I’m pretty independent and this About Me section’s probably different from others you’ve read. And that is okay. Our stories write themselves—Mine's full of passion, creativity, and drive to make a real difference. If you ever want me to expand on it, just reach out! I’m looking forward to meeting others interested in learning and collaborating.

positions.title: Software Developer/Operations Manager
positions.locationName: Greater New York City Area · Hybrid
positions.description:
The Gifted Sounds Network, dba Gifted Media Productions, is a podcasting/multimedia creation, production, and distribution network of talented and diverse individuals who are passionate about their interests and the GS family. Where I fit in is I am very passionate about having fun show ideas realized, directing commercials, producing interviews, coordinate group outings, holding bonding exercises, and in the overall promotion of the network.

Here are some of the ways I achieve this:
• Hold quarterly virtual/phone call meetings to update podcast hosts, production team, and support for 20+ individuals
• Offer impromptu post-production assistance on multimedia projects using the Adobe CC and CS family of software
• Transcribe audio for accessibility of content
• Scout locations for remote recordings of videos, esp. for the integration of green screens for animations
• Discuss analytics with the content, production, creative, and marketing teams for future goals
• Rent equipment from Adorama, BRIC Arts Media, B&H, and private rental companies/retailers
positions.insights: Skills: Public Speaking · Web Development · Online Research · Audio Post Production · Transcription · Data Entry · PHP 5.3 · Social Networking · Photoshop · Creative Services · CSS · Video · Procurement Contracts · Operations Administration · Social Media

positions.title: STEAM Specialist
positions.locationName: White Plains, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Deliver In-Person STEAM Curriculum: Teach a self-developed, hands-on STEAM curriculum to over 300 elementary students (ages 5 to 11+) across eight schools in White Plains, NY, fostering foundational skills in science, technology, engineering, art, and math.
• Classroom Coordination and Activity Facilitation: Lead engaging, hands-on STEAM activities for 20+ students per session in two-hour blocks, five days a week. Coordinate with school staff to maintain a structured and supportive environment, allowing for smooth, multi-step project completion.
• Material Preparation and Adaptation: Independently source, adapt, and create lesson materials tailored to diverse age groups, supporting inquiry-based learning and promoting creativity through recycled and sustainable materials.
• Staff Instruction: Provide guidance and instruction to school staff members on ways to support STEAM activities, establishing a collaborative and supportive environment.
• Student Engagement and Enthusiasm: Leverage extensive teaching experience and recognized strengths in enthusiasm, helpfulness, and versatility to cultivate an inclusive and supportive learning atmosphere for all students.
positions.insights: Skills: Curriculum Development · Youth Engagement · Coordinating Activities · Online Research · Teamwork · Teaching

positions.title: Frontend React Developer (Volunteer)
positions.description:
• Implement React JS conversion of 120 completed Adobe XD site layouts 
• Outline the formation of all endpoints and database schema in PostgreSQL
• Perform “glue work” contributions by reaching out and ramping up new FE volunteers and interns
• Actively participate in office hours, hackathons, and TDD pair programming with other ICs
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Online Research · TypeScript · Creative Services · CSS · Git · npm · Technical Documentation

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Building features out for the Mailchimp Marketing Platform, making it a stronger, multichannel tool for businesses of all kinds:

- Write and maintain scalable, efficient code for the Mailchimp application.
- Share expertise on Experimentation tools and techniques with Product engineers across teams through code reviews, 1-on-1 discussions, and knowledge exchange group meetings.
- Research and propose already-existing, internal and third-party library tools to support new approaches to work in order to serve the best practices for my team.
- Work with Design talent to build features from concept through implementation.
- Work independently with minimal supervision.
- Embrace and demonstrate our values: humility, creativity, and independence.
- Foster an inclusive community on the team and at Mailchimp.
positions.insights: Skills: Online Research · PHP 5.3 · Social Networking · Photoshop · CSS · Technical Documentation · MySQL · Social Media

positions.title: Programming Instructor, Disrupt Harlem Code Squad
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · On-site
positions.description:
• Instructed 12 young adult learners by boosting confidence, resilience, and mastery through real-world coding challenges.
• Guided students in delivering 100% pitch-approved, portfolio-ready capstone projects
• Curated a revamped curriculum which boosted final project completion rates within an average cohort period.

positions.title: Assistant to Programming Instructor, Disrupt Harlem Code Squad
positions.description:
Reinforce instructor lessons on beginner's level web programming for Cohort 6 participants by:
• Providing one-on-one guidance on difficult programming concepts
• Began peer programming practice with participants unfamiliar with the experience
• Demonstrated scripting program techniques for participants to observe and ask questions along the way

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description:
Freelance web design and development for artists and entrepreneurs

Some of the many tasks I do as a freelance web developer was the following:
- Partner with web designers, graphic artists, animators, audio, and video engineers to tailor an experience a client desires for their visitors to have
- Used platforms like Wordpress and Drupal for clients to be able to take over a website's updating needs and feel empowered in having a larger amount of control than they experienced with prior developers
- Worked with clients to pay an affordable rate based on the features of the website, their budget, current financial standing, and near-future earning potential
- Maintained an understanding of web technologies through continuing education, workshops, and self-study
- Communicated with web hosting and network personnel to address hardware or software issues affecting websites.
positions.insights: Skills: Online Research · PHP 5.3 · WordPress · Photoshop · Creative Services · CSS · Video · MySQL · Social Media

positions.title: Summer Camp Technical Lead Instructor
positions.description:
What can I say about Black Girls CODE! other than to gush over the life-changing organization?

With Black Girls CODE I accomplished the following:
- Instructed young girls and ladies ages 11 to 17 across two summer tech camps: Boston and New York.
- Covered a broad array of topics around web and mobile app development, entrepreneurship, startup culture, and on delivering great pitches and presentations.
- Worked closely with the Curriculum Director of all summer camps to ensure that the set curriculum is covered thoroughly, while having the freedom to add on to the curriculum as I saw fit.
- Collaborated with the Teaching Assistant and all technical volunteers, encouraging all team members to collaborate around and contribute to lessons where their careers and expertise fit in.
- Utilized tools that are accessible to all students and team members, for continued learning and use outside of the summer camp. This ensured the continuation of all student's growth and experience in programming and on their personal projects.
positions.insights: Skills: Public Speaking · Online Research · Social Networking · CSS · Video · Technical Documentation · Social Media

positions.title: Technical/Production Artist
positions.description:
The Production Artist acts as a bridge between the artists and programmers working on a game. They ensure art assets can be easily integrated into a game without sacrificing either the overall artistic vision or exceeding the technical limits of the chosen platform.

The role is a relatively new one for the games industry, but is becoming increasingly important as consoles and PC hardware becomes more complex.

Despite their technical knowledge, the Production Artist works part of the art team, and coordinates closely with the lead artists and the art director, as well as the lead programmers.
positions.insights: Skills: Online Research · Photoshop · Creative Services · Video · Social Media

honors.title: Cate Riley Innovation for Quality Grant - "KidScript"
honors.description:
Winner, KidScript: KidScript promotes STEAM education and media literacy with the magic of improv, CYOA games, and student-driven creativity. The monthly lessons culminate with a performance the students brainstorm, direct and act in. Cue cards, robotics, A/V equipment, and more are used by student supporters.

About the Grant: The Child Care Council of Westchester, Inc. established this special fund in 1998 to honor Cathryn A. Riley and all her contributions to the field of early care and education.

The Fund furthers program development, community partnerships, leadership activities and independent research. In its re-launch in 2016, the Fund began to support the Cathryn A. Riley Innovation for Quality Prize to recognize innovations linked to improvements in early care and education quality.
honors.issuer: Issued by Child Care Council of Westchester · Jul 2025

volunteerExperiences.description:
As a long-time volunteer I'm proud of the accomplishments I've seen in the NYC chapter.

Some of the many tasks and achievements I've carried out are the following:
- Lead one of the first Black Girls CODE "Web Page in A Day" workshops in the NYC chapter to girls ages 2 (yup) to 12.
- Assisted the students in navigating Windows 10 when it first came out on the donated computers
- Assisted the students in using and various code editors 
- Some workshops I participated in: Build a Webpage in a Day NYC and Build A Game in a Day with Scratch

projects.title: BuzzBites (prototype)
projects.description:
BuzzBites is for anyone searching for awesome restaurants, just a short walk away. You don't need to go on Foursquare or Instagram: It's all here on BuzzBites!

A terrific web site ui, BuzzBites connects different APIs together to take the work out of searching for places when you have a visual sensibility.

projects.title: MekeMaZy
projects.description:
MekeMaZy – An HTML5 canvas-based maze game using Javascript and jQuery
•	User interface of HTML5 Canvas and CSS3 
•	Game logic using Javascript and jQuery
•	Version control through Github repository
